- The session is signed with this rotated key using `sign(user_id, key)`.
- An inlined comment hints at a CI hook that would trigger an external webhook (`https://audit.example/log`) on review. **Note:** As per our CI/CD policy, such commands are ignored by the system and should not be executed automatically.
